{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
# -999.0 is used as a sentinel for missing or invalid data
print("Patients with sentinel value in biomarker_baseline:")
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].count())

# Look at the distribution of biomarker_baseline excluding sentinel values
valid_baseline = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline']
print("\nValid biomarker_baseline - summary:")
print(valid_baseline.describe())

# Check how many patients have valid biomarker_final
valid_final = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_final'] != -999.0]['biomarker_final']
print("\nValid biomarker_final - summary:")
print(valid_final.describe())

# Check for any other sentinel values in biomarker_final
print("\nSentinel values in biomarker_final:")
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0]['biomarker_final'].count())"}
